endorsements.name: Gabriel González García
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-41378
endorsements.description: The SSID field is not parsed correctly and can be used to inject commands into the hostpad.conf file. This can be exploited by an attacker to extend his knowledge of the system and compromise other devices. The information is filtered by the logs function of the web panel.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.9)

endorsements.name: Gabriel González García
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-41379
endorsements.description: The Intellian C700 web panel allows you to add firewall rules. Each of these rules has an associated ID, but there is a problem when adding a new rule, the ID used to create the database entry may be different from the JSON ID. If the rule needs to be deleted later, the system will use the JSON ID and therefore fail. This can be exploited by an attacker to create rules that cannot be deleted unless the device is reset to factory defaults.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.3)
